deep.surprise_reason: The page is purely administrative: a cancelled reading list plus examination and student topics on standard 19th-century analysis. It mildly documents Hilbert's interest in Poincaré's Acta work around 1890 and his teaching or examining in Königsberg. The name Siedentopf is a minor biographical detail. There is no new mathematics.
